mapper.sql: id, source_type AS sourceType, source_id AS sourceId, language, format, scope, status, creator_id AS creatorId, creator_role AS creatorRole, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, review_time AS reviewTime, review_remark AS reviewRemark, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dialogue_version (source_type, source_id, language, format, scope, creator_id, creator_role, status, reviewer_id, review_time, review_remark) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{language}, #{format}, #{scope}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorRole}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewTime}, #{reviewRemark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dialogue_version SET status = 2, reviewer_id = NULL, review_time = NULL, review_remark = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 2
